description: List the workspace's sales channels (retail, horeca, b2b ...), by key. A storefront sends a channel's key to be priced from the price lists published to it: per product the buyer's own or company list wins, then the channel's dated list whose window holds now, then its base (undated) list, then the catalogue. Each channel has key (what the storefront sends, fixed once created), name, displayMode (net or gross prices for visitors and customers without a company), priceAccess (PUBLIC - anyone; MEMBERS - signed-in customers, registration is open; COMPANY_MEMBERS - buyers of an approved company), activePriceList (the list pricing it now), priceLists (every list published to it), nextChangeAt (when its prices next change) and activeCartCount (open carts on it). Read-only.
name: list_sales_channels
title: List sales channels
